title: Dorothy and the Wizard in Oz - Ch. 3 - The Arrival of the Wizard
summary: Dorothy and the Wizard in Oz by . Dorothy and the Wizard in Oz was the fourth of 14 Oz books written by L. Frank Baum (1856-1919). Published in 1908, while Baum was resident in Coronado, California, it is considered one of the “darker” of the Oz tales.
